original_caption: Situational Awareness Check ✅ Do you fully understand the flight plan and airspace rules? ✅ Have you checked the weather conditions and visibility? ✅ Are you aware of nearby obstacles, people, and potential hazards? ✅ Do you have an emergency plan in case of signal loss or failure? Regulatory Compliance Check ✅ Do you have a valid Remote Pilot Certificate (RPC)? ✅ Has the flight been approved by the Digital Sky Platform (if required)? ✅ Are you complying with DGCA-mandated safety guidelines? | 🚨 If you answer "NO" to any of the above, do NOT proceed with the flight.
contextual_text:
Situational Awareness Check
✅ Do you fully understand the flight plan and airspace rules?
✅ Have you checked the weather conditions and visibility?
✅ Are you aware of nearby obstacles, people, and potential
hazards?
✅ Do you have an emergency plan in case of signal loss or
failure?
Regulatory Compliance Check
✅ Do you have a valid Remote Pilot Certificate (RPC)?
✅ Has the flight been approved by the Digital Sky Platform (if
required)?
✅ Are you complying with DGCA-mandated safety guidelines? 🚨 If you answer "NO" to any of the above, do NOT proceed
with the flight. 43 Drone Pilot Pre-Flight Self-Check Before operating a drone, pilots must assess their physical,
mental, and environmental conditions to ensure safety. Personal Health & Readiness Check
✅ Are you physically fit and free from fatigue?
✅ Have you had adequate rest before the flight?
✅ Have you avoided alcohol or drugs in the last 24 hours?
✅ Are you mentally focused and free from distractions or
stress?
